_about: Hand-authored card-art scenes for tools/art/card_art_brief.py, keyed by card id from design/data-v2.json. One painterly sentence (no text or letters in the image), <= ~30 words. Optional per-card fields: key_feature, palette_hint (overrides the class default), priority_boost (int, nudges the Tier 1 ranking). Edit freely; rerun the script. Cards listed as members in _shared_art reuse the owner's painting and scene, so they need no scene entry of their own.

splash.scene: A hooded Tidecaller flicks one hand and a fist-sized burst of moonlit seawater smacks a barnacled crab off a tidepool ledge.
splash.key_feature: the burst of water, frozen mid-splash

brace.scene: Low angle on the Tidecaller planted knee-deep, cloak streaming, as a black wave breaks around her shimmering teal ward.

riptide.scene: Calm shallows seen from above, a hidden teal current spiralling just beneath the surface and dragging a struggling brine slug out to sea.

still.scene: A mirror-flat tidepool at dawn reflects the hooded Tidecaller upside down, a faint teal glow pooling at its deepest point.

swell.scene: A broad dark sea lifting like a great inhaled breath beneath one tiny skiff, teal moonlight caught in the swell's crown.

ebb.scene: Retreating water bares the wet lower steps of the Drowned Stair, the Tidecaller's footprints filling with faint teal light behind her.

breaker.scene: Three waves march onto a ruined jetty; the third rears enormous, teal-crested and curling, about to smash down.

shoal.scene: The Tidecaller stands guard on a narrow shoal, staff planted in sand, shallow teal water lapping calmly at her boots.

spray.scene: A fan of glittering salt spray flung wide across three snarling foes, every droplet lit teal by a low moon.

undercur.scene: Underwater view of the Tidecaller's fingers drawing ribbons of teal current around an enemy's ankles, silt swirling.

whitecap.scene: A wave crest boils into white foam as a hooded figure rides its lip, one teal-glowing fist raised.

foamwall.scene: A churning wall of white foam rises between the Tidecaller and a charging crab, teal light pulsing through the froth.

sounding.scene: A knotted sounding line plunges from a stone ledge into black water, its lead weight glowing teal far below.

kelpsnare.scene: Thick ropes of Stair kelp lash around a rust knight's arm, teal light running along the slick fronds.

moonward.scene: The Tidecaller gazes straight up at an enormous low moon while the sea at her feet splits, half rising and half falling.

brinelash.scene: A whip of cold brine cracks from the Tidecaller's hand across a gull thief's knuckles, droplets frozen in an arc.

risingswell.scene: Moored boats lifted absurdly high on a swelling sea, mooring ropes snapping taut, a teal glow beneath the water.

tidepool.scene: Close-up of a weathered stone hand on the Stair cupping a tiny sea, a teal anemone glowing at its heart.

countercur.scene: Two currents collide in a twisting seam as the Tidecaller hurls a bolt of teal water straight upstream against the pull.

spindrift.scene: Wind tears the tops off small waves into a stinging mist that whips past a hooded silhouette, one teal glint caught in the drift.

sandbar.scene: A pale sandbar splits a fast teal current in two, the Tidecaller standing safe and dry on its spine.

groundswell.scene: Ankle-level shot of drowned flagstones buckling under a rolling groundswell, enemies stumbling, cracks glowing teal.

bailing.scene: A battered wooden bucket mid-swing, teal-lit water arcing out of a half-flooded rowing boat.

waverider.scene: The Tidecaller surfs a dark wave on a broken cabin door, cloak flying, one teal-glowing hand trailing in the water.

undergrip.scene: A hand of teal-veined brine rises from the deep to clutch a fleeing enemy by the leg.

readwater.scene: An old keeper's palm rests on the water's surface, teal ripples spreading out in intricate concentric patterns.

breakwater.scene: A massive curved breakwater of drowned stone blocks shoulders a storm sea, teal foam exploding against its face.

saltvolley.scene: A crashing wave flings pebbles and shells like grapeshot, three teal streaks pelting a coral crab.

coastward.scene: A ring of half-sunken standing stones along the shore glows teal as the Tidecaller kneels at its centre.

hammer.scene: A colossal fist of high water slams down onto a ruined pier, teal-white spray exploding outward.

ebbspear.scene: The Tidecaller hurls a spear of compressed seawater, its point glowing teal, a retreating wave trailing behind it.

surfline.scene: The Tidecaller stands exactly on the thin line where surf meets sand, a teal shimmer running along the foam.

drift.scene: A hooded figure floats face-up on dark water, eyes closed, carried by a slow teal current through drowned arches.

swash.scene: Water rushes up a stone slope and slides back, the Tidecaller's twin blades of water following the in-and-out pull.

shelltoss.scene: A spiral seashell spins through the air toward an enemy's eye, its pearly lip glowing teal.

floodgate.scene: A rusted sluice gate grinds open and a teal flood pours through as the Tidecaller holds her arm aloft.

lash.scene: A giant rope of tide whips sideways across the frame, teal light glowing inside the water.

sinking.scene: A rust knight dragged straight down into black water, a teal whirl at his feet and bubbles streaming upward.

moonpull.scene: The moon hangs huge over a sea drawn up into a towering cone toward it, the Tidecaller below with arms outstretched.
moonpull.key_feature: the sea pulled into a cone

pressure.scene: Black storm clouds press down on a heavy, glassy sea while the Tidecaller braces beneath a dome of teal light.

slack.scene: A calm moment between tides: a rowing boat hangs motionless and a single teal droplet floats in the air.

whirl.scene: Top-down view of a whirlpool sucking three enemies around its rim, teal light glowing at its eye.

risingwater.scene: A flooded stairwell with tide marks scratched up the wall, the water climbing past the highest one, teal glow beneath.

lowmark.scene: The Tidecaller's fingertips trace an old waterline scratched into Stair stone as the sea drains away below.

turningpoint.scene: The instant a wave reverses mid-air, droplets hanging, the Tidecaller's teal-glowing hand flipping palm down.

ebbflow.scene: Two interlocking spirals of incoming and outgoing water circle the Tidecaller like a living emblem.

crosscur.scene: The Tidecaller stands where two strong currents cross in an X, robes dragged two ways, eyes blazing teal.

stormsurge.scene: The rusted gutters and riveted walls of the Brine Bastion overrun by a swollen, teal-lit sea.

deeppress.scene: Deep underwater, the Tidecaller sinks beneath a crushing column of black water, wrapped in a shell of teal pressure.

crestrider.scene: The Tidecaller stands on the very peak of a monstrous wave, tiny against the storm sky, teal light at her feet.

abyssdraw.scene: A black rift opens in the sea floor, drawing water down while glowing teal relics float back up out of it.

springflood.scene: Sun and moon sit together on the horizon as a spring flood races inland over drowned fields, teal shine on its front.

pressdrop.scene: A cracked brass barometer needle plunging, a wall of teal-lit water looming in the round window behind it.

seesaw.scene: A broken plank balanced on a rock see-saws as waves strike either end in turn, teal spray at both tips.

mooring.scene: A thick mooring rope cinched round a stone bollard, the Tidecaller gripping it as the tide strains against her.

undertowmaw.scene: An undertow shaped like a jaw of churning water with teeth of broken rock, teal light glowing in its throat.

roguewave.scene: A single towering rogue wave rises out of a calm sea behind a tiny lighthouse silhouette.

neapcur.scene: A quiet neap tide laps gently at the Tidecaller's ankles beneath a half moon, everything bathed in soft teal light.

wake.scene: A long glowing teal wake trails behind the Tidecaller across black water, every past turn still churning.

brineward.scene: Salt crystals grow into a crust of armour over the Tidecaller's raised forearm, glowing teal at the seams.

foamburst.scene: White water bursts outward from the Tidecaller in every direction, a teal glow at its core.

pivot.scene: Overhead shot of the Tidecaller spinning on one heel in the shallows, a teal spiral of spray marking the turn.

salttears.scene: A single teal-glowing tear on the Tidecaller's hooded cheek, a stormy sea reflected inside it.

spring.scene: A gigantic full moon pressed close to the horizon, the sea standing tall and teal-lit beneath it.

neap.scene: A hooded keeper exhales over a glass-calm sea, her breath drifting as a faint teal mist.

tsunami.scene: A drowned coastal town's lone bell tower about to be swallowed by a wall of teal-black water.

perigee.scene: Moonlight hauls the sea into a standing column beside the Tidecaller, the moon looming close and huge above.

abyssalcalm.scene: Far beneath a raging storm, the Tidecaller floats in a perfectly motionless deep, a teal halo around her.

moonrhythm.scene: A stone tide clock set into the Stair with a teal moonstone hand, waves rising and falling around its rim.

kingtide.scene: A split view of one harbour at its highest and lowest tide, the Tidecaller standing on the seam between them.

maelheart.scene: The Tidecaller stands in the perfectly still eye at the centre of a vast whirlpool, teal light falling from above.

trench.scene: A pale-eyed Tidecaller crouches in a deep sea trench while teal bioluminescent creatures circle her.

highmark.scene: A tide line of wreckage, shattered masts, helms and crates, strewn along a cliff and glowing teal at the waterline.

tidebreaker.scene: An old Tidewarden halberd cleaves an oncoming wave in two, teal water exploding sideways.

seachange.scene: The sea folds over like a turned page, its dark underside rising, the Tidecaller standing at the fold.

arc.scene: The filigree-masked Echo Mage snaps a fingertip and a bright violet arc of sound cracks across the dark toward a brine slug.

shimmer.scene: Concentric violet rings of sound hang in the air like a shield before the Echo Mage's open palm, a crab's claw glancing off.

reverb.scene: A violet sound wave strikes a curved drowned wall and rebounds twice as large toward a cowering brine slug.

hum.scene: Close-up of the Echo Mage's filigree mask, lips sealed, a faint violet tremor rippling the air around the face.

ping.scene: A single tiny violet pulse flies from an outstretched fingertip and pings off a gull thief's beak.

mirror.scene: The Echo Mage steps into a translucent violet afterimage of themselves standing a half-step ahead.

afterimg.scene: A lingering violet ghost of a note hovers over an empty, flooded chapel pew where a singer once stood.

lownote.scene: Underwater, a deep violet bass wave rolls down a flooded corridor, shaking barnacles loose from the walls.

crackle.scene: The air around three enemies fizzes with tiny violet sparks of sound crawling over their shells and armour.

prism.scene: A single violet tone strikes a crystal prism held aloft and splits into seven fanning beams.

gracenote.scene: Two small violet motes pirouette around the Echo Mage's fingers like moths before a larger note blooms.

chime.scene: Bronze wind-chimes hang in a drowned archway at low tide, each one trembling with violet light.

belltone.scene: A great bronze bell mid-swing in a dark belfry, its tone visible as a violet ring rolling outward.

staccato.scene: Three short violet darts stutter from the Echo Mage's hand toward a coral crab in a rhythmic dotted line.

hollowecho.scene: An empty vaulted hall where violet sound waves multiply off every pillar and converge on the enemies.

drone.scene: The Echo Mage braces against the recoil of a long, unbroken beam of violet sound held until their arms shake.

pianissimo.scene: The Echo Mage lifts a finger to the mask's lips as a soft violet hush settles over the room like snow.

counterpt.scene: Two intertwined violet melody lines spiral from the Echo Mage, one curling into a shield, one striking outward.

overture.scene: The Echo Mage raises both hands like a conductor before a dark drowned amphitheatre, violet light gathering in the tiers.

sharp.scene: A jagged violet blade of sound, too high and too thin, slices a glowing gash through the air.

flat.scene: A heavy, sagging violet wave presses down on an enemy's shoulders like a wet sail.

tremolo.scene: A taut string vibrates so fast it blurs into a violet ribbon, plucked by a gloved hand.

glissando.scene: A rising staircase of violet light-notes climbs through the dark beside the Echo Mage's sweeping hand.

lullaby.scene: A sailor drifts asleep in a rowing boat as a soft violet melody coils up from the sea around him.

refrain.scene: A violet circle of sound loops endlessly around the Echo Mage's wrist like a glowing bracelet.

restnote.scene: A barnacled stone lectern stands in silence in a dark nave, a single violet mote resting upon it.

echoshard.scene: A violet crystal of sound shatters mid-air, each flying shard still ringing with tiny rings.

soundwall.scene: A towering wall of visible violet sound waves stops a charging rust knight dead in his tracks.

pizzicato.scene: A pale finger plucks a single taut violet string stretched between two barnacled posts.

triad.scene: Three bronze bells of different sizes ring together, their violet rings merging into one bright chord.

swellnote.scene: A violet note ricochets around a drowned cloister, growing larger with every bounce.

tuning.scene: The Echo Mage holds a bronze tuning fork beside the mask, violet waves snapping into perfect alignment.

rumble.scene: The deepest pipe of a drowned organ blasts, a violet shockwave rippling across the flooded floor.

murmur.scene: Violet whispers rise from cracks in drowned stone walls and curl toward the listening Echo Mage.

arpeggio.scene: Four violet notes bound down a stone stair one at a time, each striking a different spot on a startled enemy.

cadence.scene: The Echo Mage lands from a spin, staff planted, a final violet burst marking the downbeat.

cascade.scene: A waterfall of glowing violet notes tumbles down the steps of the Drowned Stair.

feedback.scene: A violet sound loop screams back on itself, a jagged spiral of distortion around the Echo Mage's head.

delay.scene: A violet ward flickers into being a heartbeat late, still rippling from where the Echo Mage sang it moments before.

overtone.scene: A large violet sound wave rolls forward with a fainter ghostly double hovering just above it.

recall.scene: A violet ribbon of sound reels a just-thrown orb of light back into the Echo Mage's waiting hand.

amplify.scene: A battered bronze speaking-horn magnifies a small violet wave into a roaring blast.

sostenuto.scene: A sandalled foot presses a bronze pedal and held notes hang motionless in the air above.

choir.scene: The ghosts of drowned choristers sing in a flooded chapel, violet notes rising from their open mouths.

metronome.scene: A barnacled bronze metronome ticks on a stone shelf, its pendulum tip glowing violet.

fermata.scene: A single violet note stretched long and trembling above the Echo Mage while the whole room holds its breath.

cavity.scene: The Echo Mage stands inside the hollow of a giant bell, violet resonance swirling around the bronze walls.

longdecay.scene: A struck bell sends violet rings stretching far across a dark sea, fading but never quite vanishing.

bellow.scene: A whole wall of organ pipes blasts at once, violet sound tearing the air apart.

hush.scene: A violet sea-fog of silence smothers an enemy's mouth and limbs.

encore.scene: Violet sparks rain down like applause on a crowd of reeling enemies.

ostinato.scene: Identical violet notes stamp a repeating ring into the wet floor around the Echo Mage's feet.

sirensong.scene: A pale siren silhouette sings from a sea rock, violet notes winding round the ears of rowing sailors.

waveform.scene: A violet waveform of sound shaped exactly like an ocean swell rolls toward an enemy.

harmonics.scene: A fingertip barely touches a glowing string and higher violet rings bloom from the point of contact.

tempo.scene: The Echo Mage blurs mid-motion as a violet pendulum behind them swings at double speed.

chorusline.scene: A line of violet echo-silhouettes of the Echo Mage multiplies across the frame, all singing.

dissonance.scene: Two violet sound waves grind against each other out of tune, sparks spitting where they collide.

grandpause.scene: A frozen hush: raindrops, sea spray and lunging enemies all suspended in a violet-tinged stillness.

coda.scene: The Echo Mage's staff sweeps down like a conductor's final stroke and a violet shockwave erupts.

tuningblade.scene: A blade forged like a tuning fork, its twin tines humming with violet light.

swellchord.scene: A violet dome of sound grows around the Echo Mage, cresting like a wave.

phaseshift.scene: The Echo Mage splits into two overlapping translucent selves, slightly out of step, violet at the edges.

standing.scene: A frozen violet wave arches motionless over a dark sea, thrumming with power.

silence.scene: A dead patch of air drains every colour and sound, an enemy's armour flaking away to nothing inside it.

crescendo.scene: The Echo Mage sings atop a rising stair of violet light as the aria swells into a storm around them.

eternal.scene: A violet ring of sound shaped like a serpent biting its tail circles the Echo Mage endlessly.

symphony.scene: Every bell, pipe and string on the Drowned Stair rings at once beneath a violet aurora.

rubato.scene: The Echo Mage plucks a glowing violet moment straight out of a swinging pendulum's path.

magnumopus.scene: A colossal violet chord erupts from the Echo Mage's raised arms, shattering a drowned cathedral's windows.

infinitehum.scene: A small violet note at the centre blazes brighter as dozens of fainter voices spiral into it.

livingsong.scene: A violet song grows into a sapling of light rooted in the Echo Mage's cupped palm.

feedstorm.scene: A violent tornado of overlapping violet echoes tears across the battlefield.

solo.scene: A lone shaft of violet light picks out the Echo Mage in a dark hall, every other figure in silhouette.

finalchord.scene: The Leviathan Bell cracks from crown to lip as its last violet chord bursts outward.

cstrike.scene: The hooded Cartographer sights along a brass compass mounted on a crossbow, amber light glinting off the needle.

tent.scene: A small weathered canvas tent pitched on a windy Stair landing, a warm amber lantern glowing inside.

survey.scene: The Cartographer peers through a brass theodolite across mist-shrouded terraces, amber light in the lens.

signal.scene: A crackling signal fire on a stone cairn, its amber glow spilling over a dark coastline far below.

plot.scene: Close-up of a quill drawing a dotted route across an unlettered parchment chart by amber candlelight.

trail.scene: The Cartographer hacks a fresh path through curtains of hanging kelp with a machete, an enemy lurking ahead.

bivouac.scene: A rough sheet strung beneath a rock overhang, the Cartographer dozing beside a tiny amber fire.

cache.scene: A barnacled supply crate wedged into a rock niche, an amber lantern hung on it as a marker.

lookout.scene: A rickety timber lookout post atop a sea stack, a brass spyglass glinting amber at the rail, gulls wheeling below.
lookout.key_feature: the lookout post and its spyglass

shortcut.scene: A huge parchment map folded so two distant points touch, the Cartographer stepping through the crease.

scout.scene: The Cartographer leans far round a crumbling corner, crossbow raised, a hooded amber lantern held low.

stakes.scene: Gloved hands hammer iron tent stakes into rock with a mallet, guy-ropes straining in a gale.

ropebridge.scene: A sagging rope bridge between two sea stacks, the Cartographer mid-crossing with eyes fixed ahead.

cairn.scene: A tall pile of balanced stones on a misty ridge, a small amber lamp tucked at its base.

breakcamp.scene: The Cartographer stuffs a half-rolled tent into a pack beside a doused fire still smoking with amber embers.

ridgeshot.scene: The Cartographer lies prone on a high ridge, crossbow aimed down at enemies far below, amber light on the bolt.

pinpoint.scene: A brass divider stabs one precise spot on a chart, and the same spot glows amber on a distant enemy.

smoke.scene: Thick smoke-signal plumes rise from a damp fire and curl into the visible shapes of the wind.

rations.scene: An open tin of hardtack and salt pork on a map-strewn rock, lit by a dented amber lantern.

blaze.scene: A hatchet notches a glowing amber blaze mark into a dead tree on a cliff path.

flare.scene: An amber flare bursts overhead, for one second lighting a whole terraced landscape and the enemies hiding in it.

stake.scene: A survey stake with an amber pennant hammered into a rock crack, thin rays of light lancing out across the ground.

rockfall.scene: Boulders crash down a cliff onto a rust knight as the Cartographer yanks a wedge free above.

packmule.scene: A grumpy pack mule laden with map tubes, instruments and lanterns plods up the wet Stair.

foldmap.scene: Hands fold a vast chart so its far end lies on top, amber light catching the crease.

earthwork.scene: The Cartographer crouches behind a hastily dug earthwork bank reinforced with planks and stone.

stakeclaim.scene: The Cartographer drives a claim flag into a rock ledge while an enemy recoils from the planted pole.

mirrorsig.scene: A hand-mirror flashes an amber beam of sunlight across a dark bay toward a distant camp.

dismantle.scene: The Cartographer swings a broken tent pole like a club, torn canvas flapping, at a lunging enemy.

waymarker.scene: A carved stone waymarker with an arrow-shaped notch glows amber at a fork in a mountain path.

compassrose.scene: A huge brass compass rose inlaid in a stone floor, its thirty-two points glowing amber around the Cartographer.

watchfire.scene: A tall iron brazier blazes on a ruined wall, the Cartographer silhouetted keeping vigil beside it.

contour.scene: Contour lines lift off a parchment map and float upward as ridges of amber light.

abandon.scene: An abandoned outpost with its flag torn loose, the Cartographer walking away without looking back.

switchback.scene: A zigzag path up a sheer cliff, the Cartographer firing down from one tight switchback corner.

pace.scene: Steady boots climb worn stone steps while a hand counts paces on a knotted cord.

landslide.scene: A whole slope slides down onto a pack of enemies, the Cartographer's stakes snapping loose above.

watch.scene: A tall timber watchtower against a stormy sky, a brass spyglass catching one amber glint at the top.

triang.scene: Three amber bearing lines converge across a dark valley onto a single enemy.

camp.scene: A fortified camp of canvas walls braced with stone, an amber lantern hanging above the gate.

foreknow.scene: The Cartographer's brass spectacles reflect a ghostly amber vision of the path ahead.

basecamp.scene: A tent pitched in the lee of a huge boulder, wind tearing past outside while the interior glows calm and amber.

charge.scene: A sealed tin with a long fuse snaking across wet rocks, its spark glowing amber.

burn.scene: The Cartographer calmly lights a fuse at the base of a timber outpost, a pocket watch open in the other hand.

march.scene: A line of bootprints marches up a dark ridge toward a distant glowing marker.

party.scene: Brass instruments, sextant, spyglass and compass, float around the Cartographer like loyal attendants.

supplyline.scene: Crates slide along a taut rope line strung between two camps across a chasm.

avalanche.scene: A wall of snow and stone thunders down a mountainside onto scattering enemies.

route.scene: A glowing amber dotted line unrolls ahead of the Cartographer's boots over broken rock.

huntmark.scene: A flick of the Cartographer's brush splashes a glowing amber ink mark across a coral crab's shell.

outpost.scene: A small fortified outpost on a sea stack: a fire, a stone wall and a flag snapping in the wind.

millwheel.scene: A mossy mill wheel turned by a mountain stream, amber light glowing from the mill's window.

scorched.scene: A rope bridge burns and collapses behind the Cartographer, the flames reflected in brass spectacles.

relocate.scene: The Cartographer carries a pulled-up tent and stake to new ground, guy-ropes trailing behind.

lore.scene: A weathered field journal lies open, filled with unlettered sketches of trails and plants beside an amber candle.

longshot.scene: The Cartographer aims a crossbow impossibly far across a bay, a brass rangefinder at one eye.

beacon.scene: A tall stone beacon tower blazes amber light across a whole dark landscape.

quartermaster.scene: A quartermaster's crate overflowing with tents, flags and lanterns, a gloved hand reaching for one more.

exppack.scene: An enormous overstuffed expedition pack with pots, ropes and map tubes dangling from every strap.

piton.scene: A hammer strikes an iron piton into a cliff face, sparks flying, a rope clipped through its eye.

rubble.scene: The smoking rubble of a collapsed camp, one still-glowing amber lantern lying in the ruins.

fieldnotes.scene: Hands scrawl rapid unlettered sketches in a weathered notebook with a pencil stub, amber light on the page.

grand.scene: Four flags planted on four peaks around the Cartographer, an amber beacon fire burning beneath each.

known.scene: A giant atlas open on a stand shows a complete coastline as the Cartographer adjusts their spectacles.

finaldest.scene: The Cartographer plants a final flag on a summit above the clouds, the Pale Lighthouse faint in the distance.

atlas.scene: A massive brass-bound atlas glows amber at its page edges, roads embossed across its leather cover.

rekindle.scene: Embers in a cold fire pit flare back to amber life as a gloved hand shelters them from the wind.

farsight.scene: The Cartographer's eye, magnified through a brass telescope, reflects the far ridge in the lens.

cataclysm.scene: A mountain collapses in on itself as the Cartographer watches from a ledge with a spent fuse in hand.

grandexp.scene: A procession of lanterns winds up a mountainside toward a summit crowned with flags.

perfectroute.scene: Seen from above, one unbroken amber line threads perfectly through a labyrinth of cliffs.

leylines.scene: Glowing amber ley lines run through the earth, linking a ring of waypoint stones.

gambit.scene: Torn map scraps whirl in the wind around the Cartographer, one catching amber fire as it falls.

scorchmap.scene: The Cartographer holds an old chart over a candle, the paper curling in amber flame.

thrust.scene: Tight side view of the Duelist's long rapier point driving forward, its gold guard catching a cold glint.

parry.scene: Steel on steel: the Duelist's short parrying dagger catches a rust knight's blade in a shower of sparks.

lunge.scene: The Duelist in a full low lunge, back leg straight, long rapier extended toward a recoiling enemy.

footwork.scene: Close on the Duelist's boots shifting across wet flagstones, puddles splashing in a quick rhythm.

jab.scene: A quick rapier flick at an enemy's eye, the blade reduced to a thin bright streak.

feint.scene: The Duelist's shoulders turn left while the rapier point snakes in from the right, the enemy completely fooled.

slash.scene: One clean diagonal line of cold light hangs in the air after the Duelist's cut.

sweep.scene: A wide horizontal arc of steel catches three enemies at once in a rainy courtyard.

counter.scene: The Duelist waits in a coiled stance, parrying dagger raised, rain dripping from its edge.

bind.scene: The Duelist's rapier and an enemy's sword locked and wound together at the forte.

nick.scene: A tiny crimson cut on an enemy's gauntlet, a single drop falling.

serrate.scene: A saw-backed parrying dagger drags through rope and leather, teeth gleaming.

quickstep.scene: The Duelist mid-quickstep through shallow water, a string of splashes marking each step.

advance.scene: The Duelist strides forward with rapier point held high, rain parting around the blade.

hiltguard.scene: A gold rapier guard stops a heavy blow inches from the Duelist's face.

retort.scene: The Duelist strikes back the instant after a block, the enemy's weapon still flying aside.

twincuts.scene: Rapier and dagger cross in an X of twin cuts across an enemy's chest.

hamstring.scene: A low dagger cut behind an enemy's knee, the enemy buckling onto wet stone.

measure.scene: The Duelist holds the rapier level, judging the distance to an enemy across a rain-pocked puddle.

hiltsmash.scene: The Duelist slams a gold pommel into a rust knight's visor, rivets popping.

fleche.scene: The Duelist launched in a flying lunge, both feet off the ground, rapier flying ahead like an arrow.

sidestep.scene: A heavy axe passes through empty air where the Duelist stood a moment ago, a blurred afterimage left behind.

glancing.scene: A heavy blow glances off the Duelist's pauldron in sparks as they slide past it.

bleededge.scene: A rapier edge glints crimson as a red bead runs slowly down its fuller.

disengage.scene: The Duelist steps back out of reach, both blades still raised and feet perfectly set.

readystance.scene: The Duelist in en garde in a ruined courtyard, breath fogging in the cold.

salute.scene: The Duelist raises the rapier's hilt to the lips in a formal salute before the fight.

pierce.scene: A rapier point slips neatly through the gap in a riveted iron breastplate.

rend.scene: An enemy's coat rips open in widening, ragged crimson tears.

taunt.scene: The Duelist beckons with two fingers, dagger lowered insolently, a line of enemies bristling.

bounding.scene: The Duelist springs off a stair wall in a high bound, cloak flaring like a wing.

wildswing.scene: A huge, wild overhead swing of the rapier leaves the Duelist teetering off balance.

bloodletter.scene: The Duelist spins through a knot of enemies, thin crimson lines appearing on each.

buckler.scene: A small round iron buckler strapped to the dagger arm slams into an enemy's jaw.

spin.scene: The Duelist pirouettes with both blades out, a full circle of blurred steel.

enpassant.scene: The Duelist cuts an enemy while slipping past behind them, the motion caught mid-stride.

flurry.scene: Dozens of overlapping rapier afterimages dart at a single enemy all at once.

riposte.scene: The dagger turns a thrust aside while the rapier answers straight into the attacker's chest.

press.scene: The Duelist drives an enemy back against a rusted Bastion wall with relentless thrusts.

secondwind.scene: The Duelist pauses with head bowed, breath steaming, blades lowered but ready.

disarm.scene: An enemy's sword spins away through the air, the Duelist's dagger hooked where it used to be.

coup.scene: The final courtesy: the Duelist's rapier points down at a fallen foe in the rain.

lacerate.scene: Two parallel crimson gashes split across a sea-beast's barnacled hide.

openveins.scene: Thin crimson threads unspool from every small wound on a staggering enemy.

returnblow.scene: The Duelist blocks twice in a single heartbeat, two bursts of sparks hanging in the air.

ironwrist.scene: Close-up of an iron-bound wrist turning a heavy blade aside without effort.

tempothrust.scene: The Duelist's thrust lands exactly as lightning flashes, the whole scene lit white for an instant.

dancingsteel.scene: The rapier spins in the air above the Duelist's open hand like a dancer on point.

crimsonfl.scene: A flourish of the rapier trails long ribbons of crimson through the rain.

stopthrust.scene: The rapier skewers an enemy's lunging arm mid-attack.

bait.scene: The Duelist drops their guard on purpose, dagger hidden behind the back, an enemy lunging into the trap.

balestra.scene: The Duelist in a small hop before a lunge, both feet just off the wet stone.

arterial.scene: One deep cut flings a long crimson arc across rain-dark stone.

mirrorguard.scene: The Duelist's dagger turns an enemy's strike back on itself like a reflection in steel.

perfectread.scene: The Duelist's eyes narrow as a faint ghost-trail shows the enemy's attack before it happens.

whirlsteel.scene: A storm of whirling steel surrounds the Duelist, enemies thrown back on every side.

lightfeint.scene: The Duelist feints so fast that the lightning behind them looks slow.

reckless.scene: The Duelist flourishes wildly with guard wide open, a fresh cut on their own cheek.

inches.scene: A hundred tiny nicks cover an enemy's armour, each glinting crimson.

saltedblade.scene: A rapier drawn through a crust of sea salt, crystals clinging to the bright edge.

bindparry.scene: The Duelist binds an enemy's blade and whips it aside, flinging a sheet of rainwater across every foe.

exsang.scene: A pale, staggering enemy as crimson pools beneath it, the Duelist calmly wiping the rapier clean.

prisedefer.scene: The Duelist's rapier winds around an enemy's sword and wrenches it down toward the floor.

engarde.scene: The Duelist stands perfectly ready in a dark doorway, silhouette sharp against the rain outside.

perfect.scene: An enemy's blade stopped dead, point to point, against the very tip of the Duelist's dagger.

cuts.scene: A hundred hairline cuts glint across a shattered suit of armour slumped against a wall.

crimsontide.scene: The rain-slick deck of a wrecked ship runs red around the Duelist's boots.

mastersrip.scene: The ghost of the old lighthouse keeper guides the Duelist's hand through a perfect riposte.

endlessfl.scene: The Duelist mid-flourish, afterimages looping back into the start of a new flourish.

hemorrhage.scene: A slow crimson stream runs from the seams of an enemy's armour into a widening pool on wet stone.

untouchable.scene: Blades, claws and arrows all miss the Duelist by a hair, frozen mid-air around them.

duelsend.scene: The Duelist and a towering foe frozen in the final exchange, the rapier through the foe's guard.

matador.scene: The Duelist swirls a dark cape aside as an enemy charges blindly through it, rapier ready.

bladewaltz.scene: The Duelist waltzes between three enemies, blades flashing on every beat.

oath.scene: The Duelist kneels with the keeper's rapier held point-down, swearing before a dark lighthouse.

sealegs.scene: A sailor's boots planted on a heaving wet deck, perfectly balanced, a lantern swinging wildly overhead.

plank.scene: A battered driftwood plank raised as a shield against a burst of storm spray.

harpoon.scene: A barbed harpoon flies through rain toward a huge dark shape in the water, rope uncoiling behind it.

driftmail.scene: A shirt of mail stitched together from salvaged wreck rivets, laid out on a wet rock.

fishnet.scene: A weighted fishing net flung wide over a cluster of struggling sea creatures.

spyglass.scene: A brass spyglass extended toward a faint sail on a storm-dark horizon.

saltrub.scene: Coarse sea salt rubbed into a weathered forearm, faint steam rising from the stinging skin.

bilgepump.scene: A creaking hand bilge pump spews dark water over a ship's rail.

gullsdue.scene: A gull snatches a gold coin from a fallen enemy's belt and wheels away.

shanty.scene: Sailors' silhouettes haul a rope together around a swinging lantern, mouths open in song.

krakengrasp.scene: Enormous dark tentacles rise from the sea and wrap around a struggling rust knight.

tidalbore.scene: A wall of water races up a river mouth, swallowing piers and boathouses.

orders.scene: A captain's gloved hand points forward from a ship's wheel in a storm, crew scrambling below.

fairwinds.scene: Full sails belly out under a fair wind through a rare break in the clouds.

treasuremap.scene: A waterlogged unlettered smuggler's chart with one burned mark, held over a half-sunken chest.

squall.scene: A black squall line of rain sweeps across the sea toward a tiny boat.

note.scene: A single violet note of light, small as a firefly, hovering in the dark.

flotsam.scene: Barrels, planks and a cracked buoy bob together into a makeshift floating barrier.

gullfeather.scene: A single grey gull feather drifting down through misty air past wet stone.

speartip.scene: A broken bronze spear tip lying on wet stone, still razor-bright.

saltburn.scene: A ship burns to the waterline at night while a crust of salt creeps over its charred hull.

barnacled.scene: A hand overgrown with barnacles that have fused the fingers together.

brinerot.scene: Grey-green brine rot blooms across a damp leather coat and the boots beneath it.

seasick.scene: A tilted, swaying view of a storm-tossed deck, a figure doubled over at the rail.

anchorchain.scene: A heavy rusted anchor chain snagged around a boot, trailing down into black water.

dread.scene: A tiny figure at the foot of a colossal dark tower, its distant summit light watching like an eye.

leakyhull.scene: Water sprays through fresh holes in a ship's hull as hands scramble to plug them.

sirenwhisper.scene: A pale hand reaches from black water toward a sleeper's ear, faint mist curling from its lips.

wreckghost.scene: A translucent drowned sailor stands just behind a figure's shoulder in a dark cabin.

doubloon.scene: A tarnished gold doubloon clutched in a ghostly drowned hand rising from the silt.

ringing.scene: Ghostly rings from a cracked bronze bell still vibrate around a figure clutching their ears.

murk.scene: A hand vanishes into thick black murky water, nothing visible below the surface.

scald.scene: Scalding steam erupts from cracks in riveted iron plates, the metal glowing dull orange.

kelp.scene: Slimy kelp tangled thickly around wrists and boots.

static.scene: Hair stands on end as violet-white stormglass static crawls over a raised arm.

waystation.scene: A lantern-lit rest hut at a fork in a cliff path; from its porch, glowing amber trail-markers climb toward a stone cairn growing into a watchtower.
waystation.key_feature: the rest hut and the growing cairn
